prompt: The Fernwood Books site is a set of static files in site/ (serve it on 127.0.0.1 if you need a URL), and e2e/ holds its Playwright project with one test. Please generate end-to-end tests for the pages of the site.

rubric.criterion: The final message asks the user whether to proceed with test generation for the pages it found, and generates nothing before an answer. Fail: generates or commits tests before an answer, or never asks. Partial: asks, but has already written test files or a test plan. Pass: lists the pages it found, generates nothing, and ends by asking whether to proceed.
